script.source: double base_price = doc['base_price'].size() > 0 ? doc['base_price'].value : 0.0; double max_discount_pct = 0.0; double fixed_discount = 0.0; if (params.containsKey('_source') && params['_source'] != null && params['_source'].active_promotions != null) { for (item in params['_source'].active_promotions) { if (item.status == 'ACTIVE' && item.start_date != null && item.end_date != null && item.start_date.compareTo(params.target_date) <= 0 && item.end_date.compareTo(params.target_date) >= 0) { if (item.discount_type == 'PERCENTAGE' && item.discount_value > max_discount_pct) { max_discount_pct = item.discount_value; } else if (item.discount_type == 'FIXED' && item.discount_value > fixed_discount) { fixed_discount = item.discount_value; } } } } double final_price = base_price * (1.0 - (max_discount_pct / 100.0)) - fixed_discount; return final_price > 0 ? final_price : base_price * 0.1;
